newsitem.title: CANADA: Noma sees lower 1996 segment results.
newsitem.headline: Noma sees lower 1996 segment results.

text.p: Noma Industries Ltd said on Thursday its 1996 financial results for its Christmas products reporting segment will be substantially lower than previously expected, with a loss before interest and taxes now estimated at C$22.0 million for the year.
Noma said the loss will be only partially offset by income tax recoveries, resulting in a net negative impact on after-tax earnings of around C$17.7 million.
Noma said its remaining businesses continue to perform strongly and in line with expectations.
Operating results for the Chrismas segment have been adversely affected by a substantial reduction in sales for the 1996 season in both the U.S. and Canada, along with weaker margins, Noma said.
It said the soft retail markets for these products in 1995 and have continued in 1996.

In the near term, Noma's new management team will continue to review its strategic options relative to the Christmas businesses. The review will include an assessment of the carrying value in its accounts of the Christmas assets with an adjustment to be reflected in the 1996 financial results.
